detail:
Full summary: Built the legacy relation-dedup pass (TDD): housekeeping dedup_relations flag, oldest-edge survivor, origin-precedence property folding, removeRelations across all three store layers with mirror unlink. 1615 green, build clean. Committed unreleased.
Decisions: Chose oldest-edge-survives for dedup, matching the upsert's first-by-seq merge target — any other survivor would leave the live upsert and the cleanup disagreeing about which edge is canonical; properties fold in insertion order through the shared mergeRelationProperties so declared origin survives cleanup exactly as it survives live writes; Chose to route survivor property-folding through addRelation's own upsert rather than a direct property write — one merge code path, and the mirror re-export comes free from the ExportingGraphStore wrapper; removals go through a new IGraphStore.removeRelations whose interface addition forces the wrapper's mirror-unlink delegation via tsc, same self-enforcing pattern as amendMetadata; Deferred the UNIQUE(source,target,type) sqlite index backstop again — schema migration risk under critical context; the dedup pass plus txn-wrapped upsert close the practical hole (decision-not-taken, still on the backlog)
Findings: need: before releasing the dedup pass — adversarial review round (standing practice, four-for-four on catching majors), changelog entry, then the 2.13.0 train; unreleased on main at HEAD
